info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Oregano Jacket Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Oregano Jacket Detail Management API enables businesses to efficiently create and manage detailed product information for the Oregano Jacket. This functionality is essential for e-commerce platforms, retailers, and inventory managers looking to enhance their catalog offerings. Users can add comprehensive details about the jacket, including specifications, pricing, and availability, ensuring that customers have access to accurate and up-to-date information. This API is particularly beneficial for developers integrating product detail features into retail or inventory systems.

post.summary: Create details for an oregano jacket.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to provide details for an oregano jacket, enabling the creation of a new jacket entry in the inventory system. Users can submit necessary specifications and attributes that define the jacket's characteristics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit details for the Oregano Jacket. It must be formatted as a JSON object containing all required fields for the jacket details. Ensure that the data types and structure match the specified schema.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the Oregano jacket.

CreateCatalogOreganoJacketDetailRequest.title: Oregano Jacket Order Request

oregano_jacket_id.description: Unique identifier for the oregano jacket.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity requesting the jacket.

quantity.description: The number of oregano jackets requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order should be prioritized.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the oregano jacket.

CreateCatalogOreganoJacketDetailRequest.description: Schema representing the request body for ordering an oregano jacket, including order details such as ID, requester information, quantity, priority status, and unit price.

CreateCatalogOreganoJacketDetailResponse.description: This schema represents the response structure for the successful retrieval of oregano jacket details after a POST operation.
